text: The money never looked like a bribe. No cash handed to a coach in a parking garage. Just a generous check to a children's charity.

text: On paper the foundation helped disadvantaged children. Prosecutors called it a laundry dressing bribes as good deeds.
provenance: On paper, the foundation was a charity, built to help disadvantaged kids reach for college.
In reality, prosecutors said, it was a laundry — a way to take a bribe and dress it up as a good deed.

text: Singer ran it nationwide for most of a decade, with his own staff, paperwork, and prices.
provenance: And this was not a handful of quiet favors.
It was a business — nationwide, with a client list, running for the better part of a decade.
He had built an institution of his own — a shadow admissions office, operating in parallel to the real ones, with its own staff, its own paperwork, its own price structure.

text: Most of what he sold was technically legal. Real counseling, real essay help. That business was the camouflage.
